first_host_attempt.failure: Malformed insertion in a draft-precision host fixture and architecture enumeration expectations not extended for two new SM120-only cases.
first_host_attempt.resolution: Restored the original precision fixture and explicitly tested the additional architecture envelope.

second_host_attempt.failure: registry_pending_test expected3 missing receipts and found0, in both host test entry points.
second_host_attempt.cause: The catalog test counted missing records for older GPUs below the new launch’s minimum SM. checkCuda correctly omits those inapplicable targets.
second_host_attempt.resolution: Honor targetDecision in the catalog test; add an explicit witness that missing SM120/121 records still count2, then1, then0 as valid receipts are supplied.

expanded_live_host_fixture.cause: Draft.e undefined in existing scratch-memory fixture
expanded_live_host_fixture.fix: Initialize a target engine geometry and pointer, test-only.

sanitizer_fixture_selection.failure: Extractor chose the9-byte host-test placeholder because its bytes also occurred in the binary. CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_IMAGE, before any kernel ran.
sanitizer_fixture_selection.fix: Extract exact header-sized CUDA fatbinary payloads directly from the native ELF and require one real image containing the kernel symbol.
sanitizer_fixture_selection.note: nvcc internal symbol names differ between compilations, so a later cached fatbin need not byte-match an earlier native binary.
